'''Marcin Korczynski''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 European Championship]] on 25 August 2001 with [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|WYS podracing]], according to Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2904">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-28-european-continental-2001-i-am-not-ind2904/ european-continental-2001-i-am-not-in], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 28 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-28-european-continental-2001-i-am-not-ind2904/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
